The '''XR-Duelmega''' was a model of [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Podracer [[Poorfo]] used one such pod, however it was destroyed after fellow racer [[Kidd Kareen]] pushed it into a wall on [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]].
